Class SakilaFrameworkAutoConfiguration

java.lang.Object
com.me.learning.framework.SakilaFrameworkAutoConfiguration
@AutoConfiguration @EnableConfigurationProperties(SakilaLoggingProperties.class) @ConditionalOnWebApplication(type=SERVLET) public class SakilaFrameworkAutoConfiguration extends Object
Spring Boot auto-configuration for the Sakila shared framework.

This class is loaded through Spring Boot's auto-configuration mechanism when the framework JAR is on the classpath, registered via: META-INF/spring/org.springframework.boot.autoconfigure.AutoConfiguration.imports

The library intentionally avoids component scanning and only exposes narrowly scoped beans that are safe to share across services.

    • jacksonDefaultsCustomizer

      @Bean @ConditionalOnMissingBean(org.springframework.boot.jackson.autoconfigure.JsonMapperBuilderCustomizer.class) public org.springframework.boot.jackson.autoconfigure.JsonMapperBuilderCustomizer jacksonDefaultsCustomizer()
      Enterprise Jackson configuration.

      Defaults applied to every service:

      • Java 8 date/time types serialised as ISO-8601 strings (not timestamps)
      • Unknown JSON properties ignored on deserialization (forward compatibility)
      • Empty beans do not cause serialisation failure
      • Null values included in output (explicit over implicit)

      NOTE: Jackson 3.x (used by Spring Boot 4.x) integrates JavaTimeModule and Jdk8Module natively into jackson-databind core — no separate module registration required.
